actions.title: Open an item
actions.description: Open an existing item in My App so the user SEES it. Params: itemId (required) — the id of an existing item, as carried on a My App search hit; never invent or guess an id. Returns { ok: true }. Errors if no item with that id exists.

itemId.description: The id of the item to open.

actions.title: Open an artifact
actions.description: Bring one of this app's artifacts on screen. Invoked by the shell when the user follows a cross-app pointer — a search result, an @-mention, a project link, a reference. Not intended for agent use; the app's own open actions are the model-facing ones.

objectId.description: App-local id of the artifact to open.

path.description: Storage path, for file-backed artifacts that have no object id.

collection.description: App-local collection the object lives in, when the caller knows it.

kind.description: The app's own artifact kind, for apps that route differently per kind.

fragment.description: App-interpreted portion locator (the ProjectLink/reference `fragment`). Absent or {} means the whole artifact.
